## Overview

Open Settings to choose a visual style and color preset. **Modern** follows the
Godot 4.7 control and panel treatment and is the default. **Classic** keeps the
previous Godot Hub appearance. Color presets are applied independently of the
selected style.

![image](https://github.com/MakovWait/godots/assets/39778897/0bf06bff-6c28-4282-b11e-d05106b30c8a)

In order to load custom theme read the notes below.

## Custom themes

Godot Hub reads its supported theme properties from the `[theme]` section of
`user://godots.cfg`. You can also set `interface/theme/custom_theme` there to the
path of a Theme resource. That resource is applied after the generated style, so
its values take priority.

> Tip: user:// folder can be simply opened with Setting Folder button in Settings

![image](https://github.com/MakovWait/godots/assets/39778897/9082ecc7-12b4-4e0d-84b2-9a28d1fc0126)

## Sample (user://godots.cfg)

```ini
[theme]
interface/theme/style="Modern"
interface/editor/main_font_size=14
interface/editor/custom_display_scale=1.25
interface/theme/preset="Default"
interface/theme/icon_and_font_color=0
interface/theme/base_color=Color(0.21, 0.24, 0.29, 1)
interface/theme/accent_color=Color(0.44, 0.73, 0.98, 1)
interface/theme/contrast=0.3
interface/theme/corner_radius=4
interface/theme/additional_spacing=0.5
```

> Note: Godot's editor theme is generated by editor-only code. Godot Hub accepts
> the properties it explicitly supports; other keys from `editor_settings-4.tres`
> may be ignored.
